What if we don't have `react-native-device-info`? I'm not using it, yet I have the exact same error. (RN 0.60, AndroidX enabled, Jetifier disabled)

For my case, I needed to upgrade all the libraries within the application,  
- android.useAndroidX=true
- android.enableJetifier=true
and migrate the application to androidX (using android studio) and then there were libraries that i had to fix manually
=> https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/migrate
+1  it happened during the migration process from react-native@58 to @59.

From the documentation ( https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/migrate )  you add this
`android.useAndroidX=true`
 `android.enableJetifier=true`
 
To your `android/gradle.properties`

see https://github.com/zlei123456/toAndroidX

I solved this problem in this way

I had all my firebase and gms:play-services-* dependencies in app/build.gradle implemented with force tag and now build success.
`implementation("com.google.android.gms:play-services-base:16.0.1"){ force=true }`
